annotation.title_clean: ASTM F3244-21 Standard Test Method for Navigation: Defined Area
annotation.title_en: ASTM F3244-21 Standard Test Method for Navigation: Defined Area
annotation.venue: ASTM International Book of Standards Vol. 15.13
named_instruments_referenced: WTO TBT Committee Decision on Principles for International Standards
annotation.summary_en: ASTM International standard catalogue page for F3244-21, which sets out test methods for checking whether automatic, automated or autonomous unmanned ground vehicles (A-UGVs) can navigate defined areas with limited clearance. The test areas are bounded physically, virtually or by floor markings, with obstacles and communication impairments added. It is meant for manufacturers, installers and users in manufacturing and warehousing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines scalable test apparatuses (physical boundaries, virtual boundaries, floor markings) to measure how well A-UGVs navigate defined areas
Specifies obstacles and communication impairments that can be used during navigation tests
Test results must show the A-UGV's navigation ability in a statistically significant way
Defers to safety standards such as ANSI/ITSDF B56.5 and ISO 3691-4:2020; it does not address safety itself
Says the methods may also apply to mobile manipulators and other industrial mobility equipment
